name: Documenting Large Webtext Corpora: A Case Study on the Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus
summary: Documents the C4 corpus: its sources, the text that its filters removed, and the benchmark data that it contains.

name: Fast Inference from Transformers via Speculative Decoding
summary: Introduces speculative sampling and speculative decoding: a small model drafts tokens and a rejection rule keeps the large model's output distribution exact; 2X to 3X on T5-XXL.

name: Accurate, Large Minibatch SGD: Training ImageNet in 1 Hour
summary: Trains ResNet-50 on ImageNet with minibatches of 8192 images by scaling the learning rate linearly with the batch size and warming it up.

name: Training Deep Nets with Sublinear Memory Cost
summary: Keeps only segment boundaries in the forward pass and recomputes the rest in the backward pass, giving O(sqrt(n)) activation memory for one extra forward pass.

name: Deep reinforcement learning from human preferences
summary: Learns a reward from human comparisons of pairs of trajectory segments and trains a deep RL agent on it, solving Atari games and simulated robot tasks with little feedback.

name: A general reinforcement learning algorithm that masters chess, shogi, and Go through self-play
summary: Introduces AlphaZero, a generalization of the AlphaGo Zero algorithm that learns chess, shogi and Go from self-play with the same algorithm and network architecture.

name: Sequence Level Training with Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Names exposure bias and proposes MIXER, which trains a recurrent text generator on a sequence-level metric such as BLEU with REINFORCE, moving gradually from the word-level loss.

name: Learning to summarize from human feedback
summary: Trains a reward model on human comparisons of summaries and fine-tunes a policy against it with reinforcement learning and a KL penalty to the supervised policy.

name: DistilBERT, a distilled version of BERT: smaller, faster, cheaper and lighter
summary: Distils BERT during pre-training with soft-target, masked language modelling and cosine hidden-state losses into a model 40% smaller that keeps most of its accuracy.

name: On the Parameterization and Initialization of Diagonal State Space Models
summary: Studies diagonal state space models, explains why the diagonal restriction of the S4 matrix works, and proposes S4D with the S4D-Inv and S4D-Lin initializations and a Vandermonde kernel.

name: Well-Read Students Learn Better: On the Importance of Pre-training Compact Models
summary: Shows that pre-training compact BERT models before distillation helps, and releases 24 miniature BERT models of different depths and widths.

name: An Introduction to Computational Learning Theory
summary: A textbook of the PAC model with its computational side: efficient learners, Occam's razor, the Vapnik-Chervonenkis dimension, weak and strong learning, and hardness results.

name: Empirical Evaluation of Gated Recurrent Neural Networks on Sequence Modeling
summary: Compares LSTM units, gated recurrent units and tanh units of about equal parameter counts on polyphonic music and raw speech modelling.

name: On Lazy Training in Differentiable Programming
summary: Argues that lazy training, where a model behaves as its linearization around initialization, comes from a choice of scaling rather than from over-parameterization, with bounds and CNN experiments.

name: AI as Agency Without Intelligence: on ChatGPT, Large Language Models, and Other Generative Models
summary: An editorial that argues that large language models act without intelligence and do not think, reason or understand.

name: Swin Transformer: Hierarchical Vision Transformer using Shifted Windows
summary: A hierarchical vision Transformer that computes self-attention inside local windows shifted between layers, with a cost linear in image size.

name: Delving Deep into Rectifiers: Surpassing Human-Level Performance on ImageNet Classification
summary: Introduces the parametric ReLU and an initialization for rectifier networks that keeps the variance of the signals constant across layers.

name: Improving neural networks by preventing co-adaptation of feature detectors
summary: Introduces dropout, randomly omitting hidden units during training to prevent co-adaptation of feature detectors, and reports results on several benchmarks.

name: Inverse Scaling: When Bigger Isn't Better
summary: Presents tasks from a public contest on which larger language models perform worse, and groups the causes of this inverse scaling.

name: Theoretical Limitations of Self-Attention in Neural Sequence Models
summary: Proves that self-attention models with hard or soft attention cannot model periodic finite-state languages or hierarchical structure unless layers or heads grow with input length.

name: A Careful Examination of Large Language Model Performance on Grade School Arithmetic
summary: Presents GSM1k, new problems written to match GSM8K, and finds accuracy drops of up to 8% on them, a sign that some models partly memorized GSM8K.

name: A Learning Algorithm for Boltzmann Machines
summary: Defines the Boltzmann machine, stochastic binary units with symmetric weights whose states follow the Boltzmann distribution of an energy, and a learning rule comparing co-occurrence statistics clamped and free.

name: Building Normalizing Flows with Stochastic Interpolants
summary: Learns the velocity of a continuous flow between two densities with a quadratic loss on a time-differentiable interpolant of independent samples, avoiding backpropagation through ODE solvers.

name: Fixing a Broken ELBO
summary: Reads the ELBO's two terms as distortion and rate, bounds the mutual information between data and code, and finds that models with equal ELBO use their code very differently.

name: Wasserstein GAN
summary: Replaces the Jensen-Shannon divergence of GANs by the Wasserstein-1 distance, estimated by a weight-clipped critic through the Kantorovich-Rubinstein duality.

name: Structured Denoising Diffusion Models in Discrete State-Spaces
summary: Defines discrete diffusion by Markov transition matrices, uniform, absorbing, discretized Gaussian or embedding-based, trains on the variational bound and an auxiliary loss, and relates absorbing diffusion to masked language models.

name: Generating Sentences from a Continuous Space
summary: Trains a variational autoencoder with LSTM encoder and decoder on sentences, and counters the collapse of its KL term with KL cost annealing and word dropout.

name: Importance Weighted Autoencoders
summary: Trains the networks of a variational autoencoder on a k-sample importance weighted bound, tighter as k grows, which raises test likelihood and the number of active latent dimensions.

name: MaskGIT: Masked Generative Image Transformer
summary: Generates the tokens of an image in a few parallel steps: a bidirectional transformer predicts all masked tokens, keeps the most confident, and remasks the rest by a cosine schedule.

name: Diffusion Models Beat GANs on Image Synthesis
summary: Improves the diffusion architecture by ablation and adds classifier guidance, which trades diversity for fidelity with classifier gradients, surpassing GANs in FID on ImageNet.

name: NICE: Non-linear Independent Components Estimation
summary: Maps data to a factorized latent density by stacking additive coupling layers, whose Jacobian determinant is 1 and inverse trivial, and trains by exact log-likelihood.

name: Density estimation using Real NVP
summary: Introduces the affine coupling layer, with a triangular Jacobian and a cheap inverse, and a multi-scale architecture of such layers for exact-likelihood generative models of images.

name: Implicit Generation and Generalization in Energy-Based Models
summary: Trains energy-based models of images given by convolutional networks with short-run Langevin dynamics from a replay buffer, and uses them for generation, inpainting, out-of-distribution detection and robust classification.

name: Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
summary: Compares 61 diffusion and rectified flow formulations, finds logit-normal timestep sampling for rectified flow ranks well, and scales a two-stream text-to-image transformer to 8B parameters.

name: MADE: Masked Autoencoder for Distribution Estimation
summary: Masks the weights of an autoencoder so that each output depends only on the inputs before it in an ordering, giving all conditionals of an autoregressive model in one pass.

name: Generative Adversarial Nets
summary: Trains a generator against a discriminator in a minimax game, proves that the optimum matches the data distribution through the Jensen-Shannon divergence, and introduces the non-saturating generator loss.

name: Your Classifier is Secretly an Energy Based Model and You Should Treat it Like One
summary: Reads a classifier's logits as an energy-based model of inputs and labels, whose log-sum-exp is an energy of the input, and trains both parts together with stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics.

name: Improved Training of Wasserstein GANs
summary: Replaces the weight clipping of Wasserstein GANs by a penalty on the critic's gradient norm at points between data and samples (WGAN-GP).

name: Noise-Contrastive Estimation: A New Estimation Principle for Unnormalized Statistical Models
summary: Estimates an unnormalized model, with its normalizing constant as one more parameter, by logistic regression that tells data from samples of a known noise distribution.

name: Training Products of Experts by Minimizing Contrastive Divergence
summary: Proposes contrastive divergence, which replaces the model expectation in the log-likelihood gradient of an energy-based model by statistics a few Markov chain steps from the data.

name: Reducing the Dimensionality of Data with Neural Networks
summary: Pretrains a deep autoencoder layer by layer as stacked RBMs, then fine-tunes it by backpropagation; its codes beat PCA on images and latent semantic analysis on documents.

name: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
summary: Trains diffusion models by predicting the added noise, a weighted variational bound linked to denoising score matching, and reaches GAN-level image quality on CIFAR-10 and LSUN.

name: Classifier-Free Diffusion Guidance
summary: Guides a conditional diffusion model without a classifier by training it jointly with an unconditional one and extrapolating between their noise predictions to trade diversity for fidelity.

name: Argmax Flows and Multinomial Diffusion: Learning Categorical Distributions
summary: Models categorical data with argmax flows, which lift categories to a continuous space, and with multinomial diffusion, which resamples each category uniformly with a small probability per step.

name: Estimation of Non-Normalized Statistical Models by Score Matching
summary: Fits an unnormalized density by matching the gradient of its log to that of the data, and shows by integration by parts that the objective needs no normalizing constant.

name: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes
summary: Introduces the reparameterized estimator of the variational lower bound and an encoder network that amortizes inference; with neural networks on both sides, the result is the variational autoencoder.

name: Glow: Generative Flow with Invertible 1x1 Convolutions
summary: Builds a flow from steps of actnorm, an invertible 1x1 convolution and an affine coupling layer, improving likelihoods on image benchmarks and generating high-resolution faces.

name: Loss Landscapes of Regularized Linear Autoencoders
summary: Proves that L2 regularization makes a linear autoencoder's encoder the transpose of its decoder and lets it learn the principal directions, not only their subspace.

name: The Neural Autoregressive Distribution Estimator
summary: Models binary vectors as a product of conditionals, each a one-hidden-layer network with weights shared across conditionals, so the exact likelihood costs O(HD).

name: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
summary: Trains continuous normalizing flows without simulation by regressing a network on per-sample conditional vector fields, and introduces the straight optimal-transport conditional path.

name: Flow Straight and Fast: Learning to Generate and Transfer Data with Rectified Flow
summary: Learns an ODE that follows straight lines between paired samples by least squares, proves the induced coupling lowers convex transport costs, and straightens paths by reflow.

name: Discrete Diffusion Modeling by Estimating the Ratios of the Data Distribution
summary: Learns ratios of the data distribution between neighbouring sequences with score entropy, a discrete analogue of score matching, and uses them to reverse a continuous-time discrete diffusion of text.

name: Which Training Methods for GANs do actually Converge?
summary: Analyses GAN training on the two-parameter Dirac-GAN, proves that unregularized and WGAN training need not converge locally, and proves local convergence with the R1 and R2 gradient penalties.

name: Masked Autoregressive Flow for Density Estimation
summary: Stacks masked autoregressive models into a normalizing flow (MAF) for density estimation, relates it to inverse autoregressive flow and Real NVP, and evaluates it on tabular and image data.

name: Normalizing Flows for Probabilistic Modeling and Inference
summary: Reviews normalizing flows: their definition and expressive power, coupling, autoregressive, residual and continuous-time constructions, training objectives, and applications.

name: From Principal Subspaces to Principal Components with Linear Autoencoders
summary: Notes that a trained linear autoencoder spans the principal subspace without finding the principal directions, and proposes recovering them from the decoder's singular vectors.

name: Unsupervised Representation Learning with Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Gives architecture and training rules that make convolutional GANs train stably (DCGAN), uses the discriminator as a feature extractor, and explores arithmetic on the generator's inputs.

name: Stochastic Backpropagation and Approximate Inference in Deep Generative Models
summary: Introduces deep latent Gaussian models trained with a recognition model and stochastic backpropagation, gradients through Gaussian latent variables, developed alongside the variational autoencoder.

name: Variational Inference with Normalizing Flows
summary: Builds flexible approximate posteriors for variational inference by passing a simple density through a sequence of invertible maps, including planar and radial flows with linear-time determinants.

name: Contractive Auto-Encoders: Explicit Invariance During Feature Extraction
summary: Adds the squared Frobenius norm of the encoder's Jacobian to the reconstruction loss, relates it to weight decay and denoising, and reports better pretraining results.

name: Simple and Effective Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Shows that the continuous-time bound of absorbing-state diffusion is a weighted average of masked language modeling losses, and trains masked diffusion language models close to autoregressive perplexity.

name: Improved Techniques for Training GANs
summary: Proposes feature matching, minibatch discrimination, historical averaging, one-sided label smoothing and virtual batch normalization for GAN training, and introduces the Inception score.

name: Simplified and Generalized Masked Diffusion for Discrete Data
summary: Writes the continuous-time bound of masked diffusion as an integral of weighted cross-entropy losses that depends on the schedule only through the signal-to-noise ratio, and generalizes it to state-dependent schedules.

name: Deep Unsupervised Learning using Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics
summary: Introduces diffusion probabilistic models: a forward diffusion slowly destroys structure in data, and a learned reverse diffusion restores it, giving tractable generative models with thousands of steps.

name: Generative Modeling by Estimating Gradients of the Data Distribution
summary: Trains a noise conditional score network on data perturbed at several Gaussian noise levels and samples with annealed Langevin dynamics, generating images without adversarial training.

name: Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models
summary: Generalizes diffusion models to non-Markovian forward processes with the same training objective, giving deterministic samplers that skip steps and sample 10 to 50 times faster.

name: Score-Based Generative Modeling through Stochastic Differential Equations
summary: Unifies score-based and diffusion models as stochastic differential equations reversed with a learned score, adding predictor-corrector samplers and a probability flow ODE with exact likelihoods.

name: Training Restricted Boltzmann Machines using Approximations to the Likelihood Gradient
summary: Proposes persistent contrastive divergence, which keeps the negative-phase Markov chains running across parameter updates instead of restarting them at the data.

name: Improving and Generalizing Flow-Based Generative Models with Minibatch Optimal Transport
summary: Generalizes conditional flow matching to any source distribution by conditioning on both endpoints, and pairs them by minibatch optimal transport for straighter flows.

name: Conditional Image Generation with PixelCNN Decoders
summary: Adds gated activations and separate vertical and horizontal stacks to PixelCNN, removing its blind spot, and conditions it on class labels or embeddings.

name: Pixel Recurrent Neural Networks
summary: Models images pixel by pixel and color by color with a 256-way softmax, using two-dimensional LSTM layers or masked convolutions (PixelCNN).

name: WaveNet: A Generative Model for Raw Audio
summary: Models raw audio sample by sample with stacks of dilated causal convolutions, gated units and a softmax over 256 mu-law levels.

name: Stacked Denoising Autoencoders: Learning Useful Representations in a Deep Network with a Local Denoising Criterion
summary: Trains autoencoders to reconstruct clean inputs from corrupted ones, stacks them to pretrain deep networks, and finds Gabor-like filters and competitive classification error.

name: Bayesian Learning via Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics
summary: Adds Gaussian noise scaled to the step size to stochastic gradient updates, so that with decreasing steps the iterates become samples from the posterior.

cited.version: the PDF on the author's page

name: Neocognitron: A Self-organizing Neural Network Model for a Mechanism of Pattern Recognition Unaffected by Shift in Position
summary: Proposes the neocognitron, a layered network of alternating S-cell and C-cell layers that organizes itself without a teacher and recognizes patterns largely independently of their position.

name: Lessons from a Restricted Turing Test
summary: A report on the first Loebner Prize competition of 1991 and an argument that the prize was premature and its restrictions defeat its purpose.

name: End-To-End Memory Networks
summary: Makes memory networks differentiable with soft attention over the memory and several hops, so they train end to end without supervision of supporting facts, on question answering and language modeling.

name: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
summary: Introduces the Vision Transformer, which applies a standard Transformer encoder to sequences of image patches for image classification.

name: Rethinking Benchmark and Contamination for Language Models with Rephrased Samples
summary: Shows that rephrased test samples pass n-gram decontamination yet raise benchmark scores, and proposes an LLM-based decontaminator.

name: Understanding searches better than ever before
summary: Google's announcement on 25 October 2019 that it uses BERT models in Search for ranking and featured snippets.

name: The Effects of Reward Misspecification: Mapping and Mitigating Misaligned Models
summary: Builds misspecified rewards in four reinforcement learning environments, studies how reward hacking varies with agent capability, and proposes anomaly detection of policies.

name: Wide Neural Networks of Any Depth Evolve as Linear Models Under Gradient Descent
summary: Shows that wide networks trained by gradient descent follow their first-order Taylor expansion around initialization, with closed-form dynamics for squared loss and experiments comparing networks with their linearizations.

name: When Benchmarks are Targets: Revealing the Sensitivity of Large Language Model Leaderboards
summary: Shows that small changes to multiple-choice benchmarks such as MMLU, like the order of the choices or the scoring method, move models by up to 8 positions on a leaderboard.

name: Sharp Minima Can Generalize For Deep Nets
summary: Shows that for rectifier networks common flatness measures can be changed arbitrarily by reparametrizations that leave the function unchanged, so sharp minima can generalize.

name: NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU Datasheet
summary: NVIDIA's three-page datasheet of the H100, with the technical specifications of H100 SXM and H100 NVL.

name: Re-evaluating the Role of Bleu in Machine Translation Research
summary: Argues that improved Bleu scores are neither necessary nor sufficient for improved translation quality, with examples where Bleu disagrees with human judgments.

name: Smarter, Better, Faster, Longer: A Modern Bidirectional Encoder for Fast, Memory Efficient, and Long Context Finetuning and Inference
summary: Introduces ModernBERT, an encoder-only model trained on 2 trillion tokens with a native sequence length of 8192, as a modern replacement for BERT.

name: How to Train Your Neural ODE: the World of Jacobian and Kinetic Regularization
summary: Adds optimal transport and Jacobian norm regularization to neural ODEs, which makes their dynamics simpler, needs fewer solver steps and trains faster without loss of performance.

name: The Power of Depth for Feedforward Neural Networks
summary: Shows a function on R^d that a small 3-layer network expresses but that no 2-layer network approximates beyond a constant accuracy unless its width is exponential in d.

name: The Llama 3 Herd of Models
summary: Describes the Llama 3 models of 8B, 70B and 405B parameters: data, architecture, scaling, infrastructure, post-training, safety and evaluations, and experiments on image, video and speech.

name: Decision Theoretic Generalizations of the PAC Model for Neural Net and Other Learning Applications
summary: Extends the PAC model to general loss functions and to targets that need not lie in the class, the setting now called agnostic PAC learning.

name: Intrinsic Dimensionality Explains the Effectiveness of Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary: Measures the intrinsic dimension of fine-tuning pretrained language models and finds it low, for example about 200 parameters for RoBERTa on MRPC.

name: ELECTRA: Pre-training Text Encoders as Discriminators Rather Than Generators
summary: Pre-trains a text encoder to detect which tokens a small generator replaced, which uses compute more efficiently than masked language modelling.

name: Llama 3.2 Community License Agreement
summary: The licence of Llama 3.2, version release date 25 September 2024.

name: Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for NLP
summary: Inserts small bottleneck adapter modules into each Transformer layer and trains only them, within 0.4% of full fine-tuning on GLUE.

name: The Marginal Value of Adaptive Gradient Methods in Machine Learning
summary: Constructs problems where adaptive gradient methods find solutions that generalize worse than those of stochastic gradient descent, and reports a similar gap on deep learning benchmarks.

name: Understanding the Effective Receptive Field in Deep Convolutional Neural Networks

summary: Introduces the MBPP and MathQA-Python benchmarks and measures how program synthesis by large language models improves with model size, few-shot prompting, fine-tuning and human feedback.

name: torch.nn.RNN (PyTorch API reference)
summary: API reference for the PyTorch Elman RNN module, with its update equation, its tanh and ReLU nonlinearities, the shapes of its weights and its initialization.

name: L2 Regularization versus Batch and Weight Normalization
summary: Shows that with batch or weight normalization an L2 penalty has no regularizing effect, and that it instead changes the effective learning rate of the weights.

name: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models with Simple and Efficient Sparsity
summary: Routes each token to one expert, adds a load-balancing loss and a capacity factor, and pre-trains sparse Transformers of up to a trillion parameters faster than dense T5 models.

name: Energy and Policy Considerations for Deep Learning in NLP
summary: Estimates the energy use, carbon emissions and cloud cost of training recent NLP models, BERT among them, and makes recommendations.

name: Categorizing Variants of Goodhart's Law
summary: Sorts the failures of optimizing a proxy measure into four kinds: regressional, extremal, causal and adversarial Goodhart.

name: Verified Uncertainty Calibration
summary: Proves that binning lower-bounds the calibration error of a model, introduces the scaling-binning calibrator, and analyses the plugin and debiased estimators of the squared calibration error.
